segments.name: Specialty insurance
segments.description: A specialty insurance company providing property and casualty insurance products to individuals and businesses in admitted and excess and surplus lines markets.
segments.evidence: We are a specialty insurance company that provides property and casualty insurance products to individuals and businesses.

revenueModel.text: The company earns premiums from individuals and businesses buying its specialty property and casualty insurance policies, distributed through retail agents, program administrators, wholesale brokers, and strategic partnerships.
revenueModel.evidence: We distribute our products through multiple channels, including retail agents, program administrators, wholesale brokers, and strategic partnerships with other insurance companies.

changes.text: In 2026 the company will report Surety and Credit premium as a separate line and cease reporting Fronting premium as a separate line of business.
changes.evidence: We will reorganize the presentation of our product offerings in 2026 and report Surety and Credit premium as a separate line, reflecting changes in strategy and market focus following the Gray Surety acquisition.
